ceiling_policy: Raw optimized WASM. Initially baseline plus 15%, rounded up to 100,000 bytes (11,800,000). Raised by 10% to 12,980,000 on 2026-10-29 by the maintainer, when PR #57 measured 11,807,493 bytes in CI. Increases require a reviewed edit. Raised to 15,000,000 on 2026-10-31 by the maintainer, when pmiScene (PR #83) measured 12,903,620 bytes (76,380 below the old ceiling).
